Quest: # Log: the line in the quest log and the tracker. Lines: what At says when the step is done ("|" for a new line; for visit
Type: the message when you get there).

Quest: # Waiting: what At says when you come for a bring step without enough (empty: the Log line and how many you have).
# The LAST step should happen at the giver (talk or bring At the giver): its Lines are followed by the quest's Done lines and the reward.

Log: Chop 5 logs from the oaks round town and bring them to Marta.
Lines: Five good logs! That'll keep the old hall warm a good few nights.
Waiting: Five logs is all I ask. Any oak round town will do, love.

Log: Look in on Pell by the smithy.
Lines: Marta sent you? Course she did.|Truth is, I've no ore left. The town's tools are all cracked, and nobody will sell us a pinch of tin.|There's tin in the grey rocks over the river. Bring me six lumps and I can mend the lot.

Log: Mine 6 tin ore from the grey rocks over the river, and bring it to Pell.
Lines: Six good lumps! Listen to that forge roar.|Go and tell Marta the hoes and axes will be mended by morning.
Waiting: Tin's in the grey rocks over the river. Six lumps, if you can.

Log: Tell Marta the forge is lit again.
Lines: The forge is lit? Oh, that boy. He'll be grinning for a week.

Log: Catch 4 perch at the pond over the river
column11: Lovely fat ones! Give me a moment...|There. Still warm. Take it to Captain Corin for the watch. He'll pretend he isn't hungry.
column12: Four perch for the pie, dear. The pond by the old market has plenty.

Log: Take Nan's pie to Captain Corin.
Lines: A pie? From Nan? Don't tell the lads, or there'll be none left for me.|Thank you, friend. Tell her the watch sends its thanks.

Log: Tell Nan the watch got their supper.
Lines: Back already! Did he eat it all?

Log: Best the sparring knight in the old pig pen over the river twice.
Tell Captain Corin how the sparring knight fights.
Lines: Twice? Ha! He lifts his sword high before every cut, you say? That's worth knowing.

Log: Find one of the old stone ruins in the forest round Oak Hill.
Lines: You've found one of the old ruins. Wil will want to hear about this.
They're real?! A round tower with a little window? I knew it!|I'm going to draw it. Don't tell Gran I want to go there, though. Not till I'm bigger.

Log: Mine 5 iron ore from the dark rocks in the hills and bring it to Pell.
Lines: That's proper iron. These hinges will outlast us all.
Waiting: Five lumps of iron ore. The dark rocks, mind: the grey ones are tin.

Log: Beat 4 bandits at their camps in the forest round Oak Hill.
Tell Captain Corin the roads are a little safer.
Lines: You're back in one piece! Good. I'd half a mind to come looking for you.

Log: Beat Red Hal at his camp by an old ruin in the forest.
Tell Captain Corin that Red Hal is beaten.
Lines: Beaten, and you walked away? Ha! He'll think twice before he comes near Oak Hill again.

Log: Chop 4 logs from the oaks round town and bring them to Hazel.
Lines: Good straight oak. That'll make a fine handle.
Waiting: Four logs for the handle, dear. Any oak round town.

Log: Bring Hazel 2 beast hides for the binding (deer in the woods have them).
Lines: Nice and supple. Now give me a moment...
Waiting: Two hides for the binding. The deer in the woods, dear.
